items.text: An MBA in communication, media and advertising leads to account management, brand and media planning, public relations, digital marketing and content strategy roles, and it adds value when you already have samples of campaigns, writing or analysis and a clear target role.
Choose the role family first, build samples of real work, and judge programmes by where graduates actually work and what projects they do.
Check official sources and speak to alumni before paying.
